name: Random Data Generator API
shortDescription: Seed-reproducible or crypto-random test data — UUIDs, names, emails, phones, addresses, primitives, multi-column rows
description: Agent-native synthetic test-data generator. /generate returns N values of one type (UUID, name, email, username, phone, company, address, city/state/zip, integer/float/boolean, date, hex color, IPv4, MAC, word/sentence, password). The one-call /lookup builds multi-column test rows from a {column: type} map. Supply a seed for fully reproducible fixtures (mulberry32 PRNG); omit it for Node CSPRNG randomness. Deterministic, no LLM, and no real PII — all values are synthetic. Confidence always 1.0.

endpointPricing.description: Generate N values of one type (optional seed)
